schema_migration_note: All v29 IDs preserved unchanged. New v30 records continue the stable UUID5 namespace uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 'https://github.com/CivicMirror/Civic-Data/ma-municipality-research/v29-plus').

human_review_items.reason: Official election warrant verifies a voter-elected constable seat, while annual municipal materials also list appointed precinct constables. Total elected seats cannot be normalized safely from current sources.

human_review_items.issue: Assessor name identity: Tina Floria vs Justine Floria
human_review_items.reason: Official 2026 election results use 'Tina Floria' for assessor vacancy contests; the current official Board of Assessors roster lists 'Justine Floria'. Current roster identity is serialized as Justine Floria, but the election-result identity linkage is not asserted.

Older official ballots establish an elected three-year Tree Warden, and current town budgets still fund a Tree Warden, but a current controlling election/appointment source was not located. No current elected-office row was serialized for Tree Warden.
Structure is verified, but the official roster includes a term ending in 2025; three current-holder markers remain unresolved rather than carrying stale identities.

The official dynamic school site did not provide a reliably reconcilable current six-member roster after a 2025 vacancy and January 2026 joint-convention process. Six holder markers remain unresolved.
The four-elected/one-state-appointed structure is authoritative, but the current official board roster was inaccessible during retrieval. Four holder markers remain unresolved.

human_review_items.issue: May 12, 2026 certified town-election result/current holder reconciliation
human_review_items.reason: The official Town Election Results archive still ended at May 13, 2025 at retrieval. The 2026 candidate-tracking sheet shows a contested Moderator race and four candidates for two Select Board seats; two Planning Board incumbents were the listed candidates for two seats but write-ins cannot be excluded. Five current-holder seats remain unresolved instead of inferring winners.

human_review_items.issue: Sewer Commission current roster versus five-seat legal structure and name spelling
human_review_items.reason: Acts of 2024, c. 242 fixes the commission at five elected members. The current town directory lists six apparent commissioners, including Tammy Pelletier whose one-year 2025 term expired at the 2026 election, omits 2024-elected Thomas E. Walker, and spells the 2026 winner Matthew Belden as 'Matt Beldon'. Four current holders are serialized from mutually supporting evidence; the fifth legal seat is unresolved pending reconciliation of resignation/appointment history and directory staleness.

human_review_items.issue: Legal validation of May 18, 2026 Annual Town Election
human_review_items.reason: The Town documented that the election lacked an election warrant. Governor-filed S.3148 would ratify all votes, but as of August 10, 2026 it had only been reported from Election Laws and referred to Senate Rules; no enacted validating session law was located. Current rosters that reflect the election are preserved, but legal seating of 2026 winners needs review until validation is enacted.

human_review_items.issue: Representative Town Meeting current elected seat count
human_review_items.reason: Current bylaws verify elected district Town Meeting members, but the special-act formula depends on current precinct population/configuration and ex-officio members. Exact elected seat total was not normalized, so the office remains research-only with no Post.

human_review_items.issue: Historical elected constables versus current appointed constables
human_review_items.reason: Older official reports list elected constables, whereas the 2023 official annual report lists appointed constables and no current elected-constable structure was located. v30 excludes a current elected constable Post; a controlling conversion act/bylaw would remove residual ambiguity.

human_review_items.issue: Finance & Advisory Committee nine legal seats versus seven-name current roster
human_review_items.reason: Current official committee page describes only seven named members although current structure/election materials establish nine elected seats. Two holder markers remain unresolved rather than classified as vacancies without explicit evidence.

The Town Clerk site advertises April 11, 2026 official election results, but the result target could not be fetched through the current nortonma.org/nortonma.gov redirect behavior. Structure is preserved; 29 current-holder seats remain unresolved rather than inferred from pre-election rosters.
